intent: Serialize Commit admission with insertion of the shutdown quit marker (new admitMu) so a Commit passing the closed check cannot enqueue behind the quit marker and hang (sync) or be dropped (async). Late commits keep the 'batcher is shutting down' error. Adds a sync/async regression test. Fixes #9687.
residual_risks: Shutdown now takes admitMu before close(b.closed): if a Commit is parked sending on a full b.in while commitLoop is in a slow batch commit, Shutdown's fail-fast marking (and other Commits' fail-fast) is delayed by up to one in-flight batch. No deadlock or lost request: commitLoop never takes admitMu and drains b.in until the quit marker. Commit's send/mutex wait already ignored ctx cancellation before this change. (adversarial)
Commit calls fs.Debugf while holding admitMu, so slow debug logging serializes Commit callers and delays Shutdown; the new test depends on this placement. (adversarial)

Callsite completeness is text-search only; production callers are backend/dropbox/dropbox.go:2122 and backend/googlephotos/googlephotos.go:1226, neither re-entrant from the batch commit fn. (adversarial)
testing_gaps: The regression test uses a fixed 100ms wait for Shutdown to contend; a slow goroutine schedule could in theory let it pass on unfixed code. The adversarial reader confirmed it fails on the base code and passes on the fix under -race.
No test added for a Commit issued after Shutdown has completed returning 'batcher is shutting down' (behaviour is unchanged by the diff, but the admitMu path is not directly exercised).
